description: This file defines the interface for send-side congestion control algorithms in the QUIC protocol, including the SendAlgorithmInterface class, NetworkParams struct, and related methods and constants.

classes.name: SendAlgorithmInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for send-side congestion control algorithms in QUIC.

classes.name: NetworkParams
classes.description: Struct holding network parameters such as bandwidth, RTT, and congestion window constraints.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the congestion control algorithm based on QUIC configuration.

methods.name: ApplyConnectionOptions
methods.description: Applies connection options to the congestion control algorithm.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets the initial congestion window in packets.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Updates congestion state based on ACKs or loss events.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Informs the algorithm of a packet being sent.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Informs the algorithm that a packet has been neutered.

methods.name: OnRetransmissionTimeout
methods.description: Handles retransmission timeout events.

methods.name: OnConnectionMigration
methods.description: Handles connection migration events.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if the sender can send data now.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the pacing rate of the send algorithm.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns the current estimated bandwidth.

methods.name: HasGoodBandwidthEstimateForResumption
methods.description: Indicates if the bandwidth estimate is reliable for resumption.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns the current congestion window size in bytes.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Indicates if the algorithm is in slow start.

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Indicates if the algorithm is in recovery.

methods.name: GetSlowStartThreshold
methods.description: Returns the slow start threshold.

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns the type of congestion control algorithm.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts the algorithm based on external network parameters.

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Provides debugging information about the current state.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles cases where the application is limited in sending data.

methods.name: PopulateConnectionStats
methods.description: Collects connection statistics.

methods.name: SupportsECT0
methods.description: Indicates support for ECT(0) ECN.

methods.name: SupportsECT1
methods.description: Indicates support for ECT(1) ECN.
